x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2022-01-01)
  and full text has (
    stemmed "indirect prompt injection"
    and (
      stemmed "LLM agent"
      or stemmed "LLM agents"
      or stemmed "large language model agent"
      or stemmed "large language model agents"
    )
    and (authority or authorization or provenance)
  )
  and date <= (2026-08-12)
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2022-01-01,fulltext.search:%22indirect prompt injection%22,to_publication_date:2026-08-12,fulltext.search:%22LLM agent%22|%22LLM agents%22|%22large language model agent%22|%22large language model agents%22,fulltext.search:authority|authorization|provenance&per_page=100
